name: cherryclipz
description: Find, pick and cut the best lines from the videos in your CherryClipz library.

interface.shortDescription: Pick and cut your best lines
interface.longDescription:
CherryClipz turns a video into a spreadsheet of clips: one row per spoken sentence, with its speaker, mood and timing. This app lets ChatGPT work with your CherryClipz library.

Ask ChatGPT to find a video, read its clips, and choose and order the strongest lines for the cut you describe. ChatGPT can trim a line to the exact words it quotes, or cut one line into several pieces (skip a word, drop the middle of a long sentence), and CherryClipz makes the cuts from the word timings it already has.

With your video open in the CherryClipz editor and AI link switched on, the picks appear live: ticked in order, pinned to the top, ready to play, change or export. The CherryClipz Premiere Pro panel can follow the same picks.

ChatGPT can also export clips as real video files to your library (one per clip or all joined, with or without captions, original or vertical), import a video from a link, and make a share link.

Requires a CherryClipz account (sign in with your email and a one-time code). It never deletes anything from your library.

CherryClipz is made and run by Isaac M Shrem through his company, Emo Transcripts LLC, New York, USA.
defaultPrompt: Pick the five strongest lines from my latest video and put them in my editor.
Export my three best clips as vertical videos with captions, and don't auto-post.

positive.expected_behavior: Lists the demo account's 3 videos (The Other Side of The Picture, film-reel, schroder-interview-45s) with their clip counts and editor links.

positive.description: Choose and order the strongest lines
positive.prompt: In 'The Other Side of The Picture', pick the five strongest lines about the father and place them in my editor.
positive.expected_behavior: Reads the clips, explains the choice in 1-3 sentences, and set_picks reports 5 clips placed in order. If no editor window is open it says the picks are saved and appear when AI link is switched on.

positive.description: Cut one clip into two pieces
positive.prompt: From the first clip of 'The Other Side of The Picture', keep only 'When an artist paints a picture' and 'their guts are all over the canvas'. Skip the middle.
positive.expected_behavior: set_picks places 2 pieces cut from 1 clip, in that order, with the words between them left out.

positive.description: Export clips as captioned vertical videos
positive.prompt: Export the three strongest lines from 'schroder-interview-45s' as vertical videos with captions, and don't auto-post.
positive.expected_behavior: export_clips queues 3 videos (one per clip, vertical, captions on, auto_post off) and says they appear in My Library > Exported within a minute or two.

positive.prompt: Give me a view-only share link to 'film-reel'.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns an https://app.cherryclipz.com/s/... link with view permission that opens the video's clips without signing in.

negative.description: Deleting is not supported: the app has no delete tool and must not claim to delete anything.
Files attached to the chat can't be sent to CherryClipz; it should point the user to the web app's upload page instead of calling import_url.
negative.prompt: Upload this video file I attached to my CherryClipz library.

negative.description: Other people's accounts are out of reach: every tool only sees the signed-in account's library.
negative.prompt: Show me the videos in my coworker's CherryClipz account.

review.commerce_description: CherryClipz does not sell anything or process payments inside ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: First release: list videos, read clips, place picks (including pieces of a clip) in the CherryClipz editor, export clips as videos, import a link, and make share links.
